produceCommodities.name: Fresh Organic Baby Spinach & Microgreens
produceCommodities.surfaceMorphology: Thin Fragile Cuticle with High Stomatal Density & Deep Hydrophobic Wax Micro-Grooves
produceCommodities.targetPathogens: Escherichia coli O157:H7, Salmonella enterica, Listeria monocytogenes
produceCommodities.susceptibilityToThermalBruising: Extremely High (T > 28°C causes irreversible wilting and chlorosis)
produceCommodities.description: Extremely sensitive leafy substrate vulnerable to waterlogging in immersion washers. DBD-CPM penetrates stomata with sub-15 µm droplets laden with hydroxyl radicals, inactivating internalized bacteria while preserving cellular turgor and chlorophyll a/b integrity.

produceCommodities.name: Fresh Whole Strawberries & Raspberries
produceCommodities.surfaceMorphology: Porous Receptacle Matrix, Achene Pockets, High Moisture Sensitivity & Zero-Water Wash Tolerance
produceCommodities.targetPathogens: Botrytis cinerea (Grey Mold), Rhizopus stolonifer, Murine Norovirus (MNV-1)
produceCommodities.susceptibilityToThermalBruising: Critical (Water contact induces rapid mold germination and post-harvest rot within 48h)
produceCommodities.description: Fresh berries cannot undergo wet immersion washing without severe mould outbreaks. Cold plasma dry mist delivers a high flux of short-lived peroxynitrite and singlet oxygen that destroys fungal spore coats without wetting the fruit surface, extending commercial shelf-life by 7–12 days.

produceCommodities.name: Reticulated Cantaloupe & Honeydew Melons
produceCommodities.surfaceMorphology: Coarse Netting Cavities, Sub-Epidermal Lenticels & Persistent Bacterial Biofilms
produceCommodities.targetPathogens: Listeria monocytogenes, Salmonella enterica Poona, Aspergillus flavus
produceCommodities.susceptibilityToThermalBruising: Low (Thick protective rind, but high cross-contamination risk during knife slicing)
produceCommodities.description: Reticulated melon rinds are notorious for harboring multi-species bacterial biofilms that resist aqueous chlorine. The high electric field DBD-CPM creates localized micro-streamers that penetrate deep corky netting, eradicating Listeria before transfer to inner edible flesh during commercial dicing.

produceCommodities.name: Ready-to-Eat Alfalfa, Broccoli & Radish Sprouts
produceCommodities.surfaceMorphology: Dense Micro-Canopy, Delicate Seed Coats & High Natural Bacterial Endophytes
produceCommodities.targetPathogens: Salmonella enterica, Shiga toxin-producing E. coli (STEC), Bacillus cereus spores
produceCommodities.susceptibilityToThermalBruising: Very High (Delicate hypocotyl stems buckle under mechanical agitation)
produceCommodities.description: Sprouts represent one of the highest-risk produce items under FDA FSMA regulations. DBD-CPM penetrates the tangled sprout canopy via electrohydrodynamic aerosol transport, achieving >5-log reduction of Salmonella while preserving delicate seedling crunch and sulforaphane glucosinolates.

produceCommodities.name: Fresh-Cut Diced Apples & Pears
produceCommodities.surfaceMorphology: Exposed Parenchyma Flesh, Active Polyphenol Oxidase (PPO) & Cellular Leakage
produceCommodities.targetPathogens: Listeria monocytogenes, Penicillium expansum, Leuconostoc mesenteroides
produceCommodities.susceptibilityToThermalBruising: High (Rapid enzymatic browning occurs upon atmospheric oxygen exposure)
produceCommodities.description: Cut fruit parenchymal cells release polyphenol oxidase upon slicing. Reactive nitrogen species (RNS) generated in the plasma mist competitively inhibit PPO enzyme active copper sites, arresting enzymatic browning while sterilizing exposed surfaces without chemical sulfites or calcium ascorbate dips.
